title: NPCore Field Manual
summary: Understand ECHO NPC contacts, interaction screens, dialogue, trades, services, and replacement behavior.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: NPCore turns authored profile data into interactive contacts. A contact can carry a profile, visual style, dialogue tree, trade set, service set, faction label, and replacement mapping.

blocks.title: First Safe Contact
blocks.body: Approach an ECHO NPC, right-click, read the current dialogue options, and back out if the screen reports a missing trade, service, or profile state.

blocks.title: What Matters In Play
blocks.body: Players mainly need to know who the contact is, what tab is active, what a trade or service costs, and whether a mission or cooldown is blocking the action.

blocks.title: Fallbacks
blocks.body: ScreenCore improves the page when available. Without it, NPCore keeps a classic interaction path so dialogue, trades, and services remain reachable.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If an NPC looks generic or has no useful options, check whether its profile, visual profile, dialogue, trade set, and service set loaded from the datapack namespace.
